name: linkuistics
description: Coding standards, software-design and version-control disciplines as lazily-loaded agent skills, plus GUI testing in isolated VMs. Two plugins: linkuistics and testanyware.

plugins.name: linkuistics
plugins.description: Linkuistics coding-standards skills: universal principles, per-language style guides, CLI and deep-module design, an in-flight adversarial-verify discipline, plus a user-invoked safety guardrail that gates destructive operations.

plugins.name: testanyware
plugins.description: TestAnyware GUI-testing skill: drive GUI apps in isolated macOS/Linux/Windows VMs for host-isolation, cross-platform testing, UI experiments, and documentation screenshots/recordings.
